name: algebraicIndependent_singleton_iff
script:
intro ι R A x inst inst1 inst2 inst3 i
haveI : Unique ι := uniqueOfSubsingleton i
have hd : (default : ι) = i := Subsingleton.elim _ _
constructor
· intro h
  first
    | exact h.transcendental i
    | exact h.transcendental
    | (rw [algebraicIndependent_unique_type_iff] at h; rwa [hd] at h)
· intro h
  first
    | (rw [algebraicIndependent_unique_type_iff, hd]; exact h)
    | (have e : Unit ≃ ι :=
        ⟨fun _ => i, fun _ => (), fun _ => rfl, fun _ => Subsingleton.elim _ _⟩
       have hx : x ∘ e = fun _ : Unit => x i := funext fun _ => rfl
       rw [← algebraicIndependent_equiv e, hx, algebraicIndependent_iff_transcendental]
       exact h)

name: SetRel.inv_eq_self_iff
script:
intro α R
constructor
· intro h
  first
    | exact h
    | (intro x y hxy
       rw [← h]
       exact hxy)
    | (constructor
       intro x y hxy
       rw [← h]
       exact hxy)
    | (refine ⟨?_⟩
       intro x y hxy
       rw [← h]
       exact hxy)
    | (intro x y hxy
       exact h ▸ hxy)
    | (constructor
       intro x y hxy
       exact h ▸ hxy)
· intro h
  first
    | exact h
    | (apply Set.ext
       rintro ⟨x, y⟩
       constructor <;> intro hxy <;>
         first
           | exact h hxy
           | exact h.symm hxy
           | exact h.1 hxy
           | exact h _ _ hxy
           | exact h.symm _ _ hxy
           | exact h.1 _ _ hxy)
    | (ext ⟨x, y⟩
       constructor <;> intro hxy <;>
         first
           | exact h hxy
           | exact h.symm hxy
           | exact h.1 hxy
           | exact h _ _ hxy
           | exact h.symm _ _ hxy
           | exact h.1 _ _ hxy)

name: Ordinal.log_opow_mul_add
script:
intro b u v w hb hv hw
have hb0 : (0 : Ordinal) < b := lt_trans zero_lt_one hb
have hbu : (0 : Ordinal) < b ^ u := Ordinal.opow_pos u hb0
have hvpos : (0 : Ordinal) < v := Ordinal.pos_iff_ne_zero.mpr hv
have h1 : (0 : Ordinal) < b ^ u * v := Ordinal.mul_pos hbu hvpos
have hxpos : (0 : Ordinal) < b ^ u * v + w :=
  lt_of_lt_of_le h1 (Ordinal.le_add_right (b ^ u * v) w)
have hx : b ^ u * v + w ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hxpos
refine le_antisymm ?_ ?_
· have key : b ^ u * v + w < b ^ Order.succ (u + Ordinal.log b v) := by
    have e1 : b ^ u * v + b ^ u = b ^ u * Order.succ v := by
      rw [Ordinal.mul_succ]
    have e2 : b ^ u * b ^ Order.succ (Ordinal.log b v)
        = b ^ Order.succ (u + Ordinal.log b v) := by
      rw [← Ordinal.opow_add, Ordinal.add_succ]
    have e3 : Order.succ v ≤ b ^ Order.succ (Ordinal.log b v) :=
      Order.succ_le_of_lt (Ordinal.lt_opow_succ_log_self hb v)
    calc b ^ u * v + w < b ^ u * v + b ^ u := (Ordinal.add_lt_add_iff_left _).mpr hw
      _ = b ^ u * Order.succ v := e1
      _ ≤ b ^ u * b ^ Order.succ (Ordinal.log b v) := Ordinal.mul_le_mul_left' e3 (b ^ u)
      _ = b ^ Order.succ (u + Ordinal.log b v) := e2
  exact Order.lt_succ_iff.mp ((Ordinal.lt_opow_iff_log_lt hb hx).mp key)
· have key : b ^ (u + Ordinal.log b v) ≤ b ^ u * v + w := by
    rw [Ordinal.opow_add]
    exact le_trans (Ordinal.mul_le_mul_left' (Ordinal.opow_log_le_self b hv) (b ^ u))
      (Ordinal.le_add_right _ _)
  exact (Ordinal.opow_le_iff_le_log hb hx).mp key

name: Polynomial.prod_multiset_X_sub_C_of_monic_of_roots_card_eq
script:
intro R _ _ p hp hcard
have hq : (Multiset.map (fun a => Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C a) p.roots).prod.Monic :=
  Polynomial.monic_multiset_prod_of_monic _ _ fun a _ => Polynomial.monic_X_sub_C a
obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := Polynomial.prod_multiset_X_sub_C_dvd p
have hdeg : (Multiset.map (fun a => Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C a) p.roots).prod.natDegree
    = p.natDegree := by
  rw [Polynomial.natDegree_multiset_prod_X_sub_C_eq_card]
  exact hcard
have hr0 : r ≠ 0 := by
  intro h
  rw [h, mul_zero] at hr
  exact hp.ne_zero hr
have hdd := Polynomial.natDegree_mul hq.ne_zero hr0
rw [← hr, hdeg] at hdd
have hrdeg : r.natDegree = 0 := by omega
have hlc : r.leadingCoeff = 1 := by
  have h := hp.leadingCoeff
  rw [hr, Polynomial.leadingCoeff_mul, hq.leadingCoeff, one_mul] at h
  exact h
have h3 : r.coeff 0 = 1 := by
  rw [← hrdeg, Polynomial.coeff_natDegree]
  exact hlc
have hrone : r = 1 :=
  (Polynomial.eq_C_of_natDegree_eq_zero hrdeg).trans (by rw [h3]; simp)
rw [hrone, mul_one] at hr
exact hr.symm

name: TopologicalSpace.nhds_mkOfNhds_of_hasBasis
script:
intro α n ι p s hb hself hnhds a
show @nhds α (TopologicalSpace.mkOfNhds n) a = n a
have key : ∀ b u, u ∈ n b → b ∈ u := by
  intro b u hu
  obtain ⟨i, hi, hsub⟩ := (hb b).mem_iff.1 hu
  exact hsub (hself b i hi)
refine le_antisymm (Filter.le_def.2 fun u hu => ?_) (Filter.le_def.2 fun u hu => ?_)
· have hv : ∀ b ∈ {b : α | u ∈ n b}, {b : α | u ∈ n b} ∈ n b := by
    intro b hbu
    obtain ⟨i, hi, hsub⟩ := (hb b).mem_iff.1 hbu
    exact Filter.mem_of_superset (hnhds b i hi) fun x hx => Filter.mem_of_superset hx hsub
  have hopen : @IsOpen α (TopologicalSpace.mkOfNhds n) {b : α | u ∈ n b} := hv
  exact Filter.mem_of_superset (hopen.mem_nhds hu) fun b hb' => key b u hb'
· obtain ⟨t, hts, hto, hat⟩ := mem_nhds_iff.1 hu
  have hto' : ∀ b ∈ t, t ∈ n b := hto
  exact Filter.mem_of_superset (hto' a hat) hts

name: CategoryTheory.SemiadditiveOfBinaryBiproducts.comp_add
script:
intro C _ _ _ X Y Z f g h
have key : ∀ (a b : Y ⟶ Z),
    CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp f (CategoryTheory.Limits.biprod.lift a b)
      = CategoryTheory.Limits.biprod.lift
          (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp f a) (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp f b) := by
  intro a b
  first
    | (apply CategoryTheory.Limits.biprod.hom_ext <;> simp)
    | (ext <;> simp)
    | simp
have hadd : ∀ (a b : Y ⟶ Z), a + b =
    CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (CategoryTheory.Limits.biprod.lift a b)
      (CategoryTheory.Limits.biprod.desc (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.id Z)
        (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.id Z)) := by
  intro a b
  first
    | rfl
    | simp
first
  | rw [hadd, hadd, ← CategoryTheory.Category.assoc, key]
  | (rw [hadd, hadd]
     rw [← CategoryTheory.Category.assoc]
     rw [key])
  | simp [hadd, key]
  | simp [key]

name: MeasureTheory.L1.integral_zero
script:
intro α E _ m μ _ _
first
  | exact map_zero (MeasureTheory.L1.integralCLM (μ := μ))
  | exact ContinuousLinearMap.map_zero (MeasureTheory.L1.integralCLM (μ := μ))
  | exact MeasureTheory.L1.integralCLM.map_zero
  | exact (MeasureTheory.L1.integralCLM (α := α) (E := E) (μ := μ)).map_zero
  | exact map_zero (MeasureTheory.L1.integralCLM : MeasureTheory.Lp E 1 μ →L[ℝ] E)
  | (show (MeasureTheory.L1.integralCLM : MeasureTheory.Lp E 1 μ →L[ℝ] E) 0 = 0
     exact map_zero _)
  | (change (MeasureTheory.L1.integralCLM : MeasureTheory.Lp E 1 μ →L[ℝ] E) 0 = 0
     exact ContinuousLinearMap.map_zero _)
  | simp only [MeasureTheory.L1.integral, map_zero]
  | simp only [MeasureTheory.L1.integral, ContinuousLinearMap.map_zero]
